description:
1000W Motor 48V 10Ah: This electric bike features a powerful 1000W brushless motor paired with a 48V, 10Ah detachable lithium battery. You can conveniently bring the battery home or to your office for recharging. The charging time is approximately 5-8 hours, and the battery can be charged up to 2000 cycles. The bike is equipped with a 500W high-speed brushless motor and Shimano 21-speed gears, allowing for easy riding at speeds of up to 23MPH and a distance range of 31-42 miles.

3 Working Modes:The bike offers three working modes to suit your preferences. In the Pedal Assist Mode, the motor provides moderate assistance as you pedal, allowing you to ride up to 60-90km before needing to recharge. In the Fully Electric Mode, you can twist the throttle to power the motor without pedaling, providing a battery range of 40-50km. Lastly, the Manual Mode allows you to pedal the bike normally as you would with any regular bicycle.

Intelligent Control Digital LCD Display:The electric bike features an intelligent control digital LCD display, which shows various useful information. You can easily monitor the battery level, track your mileage, and choose from five different speed modes using the display.

Foldable & Adjustable Design:With its foldable design and lightweight aluminum alloy frame, this electric bike is easy to fold and carry, fitting into an SUV or pickup truck with convenience. Whether you're commuting to work, enjoying your weekends, or going on holidays, this bike can make your commute faster and less tiring.

High Quality:The electric bike comes pre-installed at 75% and is easy to assemble. It is constructed with a durable and lightweight 6061 aluminum alloy frame, ensuring a longer service life and better shock absorption. The bike is equipped with headlights, an aluminum suspension fork, and front and rear disc brakes, providing enhanced safety and a superior riding experience.

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: 1-year warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns
